name: say
purpose: Convert text to audible speech using macOS's built-in text-to-speech engine.
explanation: Demonstrates in C03 that terminal commands are simply executable programs. Because `say` comes pre-installed on macOS, it works immediately without package installation.

parameters.description: The text string to speak aloud.

expectedOutput: (Audio output spoken aloud; no stdout text)
explanationOfOutput: Audio is played through the system speakers; standard output remains empty.
whenToUse: To test built-in macOS CLI programs or add audio alerts to local scripts.
commonMistakes: Expecting `say` to exist out-of-the-box on Linux or Windows.
commonErrors: bash: say: command not found (when run on Linux)
